mapper.select: SELECT /* homes.broker.mapper.BrokerPublicMapper.selectPublicHouseList 중개사 단지물건 목록조회 */ MST.HTBDNO , MST.BULD_REGSTR_PK , MST.BULDGB , MST.CPLX_AT , NVL(STF.OFFICENO, 0) AS OFFICENO , NVL(STF.BRKNO , 0) AS BRKNO , NVL(STF.CUSTNO , 0) AS CUSTNO , NVL(STF.SFSTTUS , 'N') AS SFSTTUS , NVL(STF.HPPSCD , MST.HPPSCD) AS HPPSCD , ( SELECT CODE_NM FROM TB_CM_COMMCODE WHERE GRP_CD = 'HPS' AND MXTR_COMM_CD = NVL(STF.HPPSCD , MST.HPPSCD)) AS HPPSNM , MST.BULDNM , MST.BULDCO , MST.PPSCD , PPS.PPS_NM , MST.HPPSCD , MST.PPSETCNM , MST.HSHLDCO, MST.FMLYCO , MST.ARCD, MST.LEGCD, MST.BUNJIB, MST.BUNJIJ , MST.BDADDR, MST.RDADDR , DATE_FORMAT(STF.CREAT_DT, '%Y.%m.%d') AS CRDE FROM TB_HBD_LEDGR_MSTR MST INNER JOIN TB_CM_REGSTR_PPSCODE PPS ON MST.PPSCD = PPS.PPS_CD LEFT JOIN TB_BRK_BULD_STUFF STF ON ( MST.HTBDNO = STF.HTBDNO AND STF.OFFICENO = #{officeno} AND STF.BRKNO = #{brkno} ) WHERE ARCD = #{arcd} AND LEGCD = #{legcd} AND BULDGB = #{buldgb} AND MST.PPSCD = '02000' /* 공동주택만 조회 */ AND BULDNM != '' /* 건물명 없는것들 일단 제외함 */ AND INSTR(PPSETCNM, '다세대') = 0 AND MST.HSHLDCO > 14 /* 15세대 이상 */ ORDER BY NVL(OFFICENO, 0) DESC, MST.BULDNM
